reason: A cross-session memory and context plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stores user-defined memories, retrieves them with hybrid search, and injects selected results into agent sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 YAML 存储、混合检索和自动上下文注入的跨会话记忆管理功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with cross-session memory management using YAML storage, hybrid retrieval, and automatic context injection.

capabilities: Persists user-defined memories in a local YAML file
Retrieves memories using keyword and embedding-based search
Injects selected memory titles or retrieved memories into agent context
Uses a local Ollama embedding service when available
Provides tools to create, inspect, list, soft-delete, and pin memories
